name: Agent Extension Supply-chain Scan
mechanism: Scans skills plugins hooks MCP manifests scripts binaries and dependencies with deterministic rules and optional semantic analysis before human review and pinned admission.
use_when: Agents install portable skills plugins or third-party MCP servers
Extension code and instructions change independently of the application
avoid_when: A scanner verdict would automatically grant authority
Encrypted compiled multimodal or staged behavior cannot be inspected
expected_effects: Earlier detection of exfiltration dangerous code and excessive permissions
failure_modes: Clean scan is mistaken for proof of safety
LLM scanner misses staged behavior or creates false positives
Scanner itself receives broad secrets or egress
